# `main.aug` specification

August 0.19.0. This document is compiled from checked code with deterministic wording guided by Simplified Technical English.

## In this file

- Run 4 other startup steps in source order.

## Startup, in source order

- Set `counter` to call [`Counter`](counter.aug.md#symbol-Counter) with `value` = `1`.
- Call `print` with `value` = call [`Counter.label`](counter.aug.md#symbol-Counter.label) on `counter`.
- Grant exclusive mutable access to `counter` for this block, then end the borrow:
  - Set `value` of `counter` to `2`.
- Call `print` with `value` = `value` of `counter`.

### [`Counter`](counter.aug.md#symbol-Counter)

Class from `counter`.

- Construct with `value`: `int` → [`Counter`](counter.aug.md#symbol-Counter).
- Read `value` (`int`); its owner can change it.
- [`Counter.label`](counter.aug.md#symbol-Counter.label) (no caller inputs) → `string`.
